label: Multi-Agent Orchestrator
summary: Parallel agent runtime requiring role boundaries, disjoint write sets, synthesis gates, and review handoff.
claim_notes: This is an adapter hypothesis for orchestrated agent systems and must be validated with run logs.
failure_modes: Synthesis before all local results arrive
rules: Define agent roles before parallel work starts.
Assign disjoint write sets for every worker.
Do not let local agents perform global synthesis.
Run synthesis only after all required local outputs exist.
Preserve unresolved disagreements in the review handoff.
